name: 80013 · Aurora, CO
findings: ZIP 80013 (Aurora) has 156 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80013 (Aurora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80013 (Aurora) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 70 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
